tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stobs 'phrog zhing skyong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī ba la ha ran+d+re k+ṣe tra pā la tsa turmu kha s+ya u pa de sha u pa sa dā ka pra kā sha ru dra shā mā li na ma gu ru ma hā kā la s+ya sa dā ya na maḥsha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha li/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje stobs 'phrog dbang po zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa'i man ngag bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba bla ma nag po chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpal ldan dngos kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /dpal ldan chen po 'og min zhing gi mgon/ /mgon po gang dang dbyer med bla ma rje/ /rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can spyi bos mchod/ /rgyal bas lung bstan rgyal tshab klu sgrub zhabs/ /lo tsā mkhas pa lo chen dar ma grags/ /gangs ljongs 'dren pa 'dren mchog sa skya pa/ /brgyud ldan dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams rgyal/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs ldan 'jam pa'i dpal/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rab mdzes zhi bas brgyan/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med stsol ba'i lha/ /yi dam 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gi yul/ /rgyal kun chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rnam 'phrul bstan bsrung dbang po skur ston pa/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi bdud dpung phye mar 'gems/ /stobs 'phrog nag po chen pos shis par mdzod/ /de lta'i man ngag zab dgu mtha' yas las/ /yang gsang sgrub pa bya tshul snying gi nor/ /drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba 'bar ba 'di/ /ma rung bdud dpung 'joms phyir bdag gis bshad/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad pa dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos srung che chung gnyis su grags pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su bab pa shin tu gnyen zhing myur ba'i srung ma mgon po chung ba zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa'am mtshan gzhan zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug sogs rnam grangs du ma zhig dang ldan pa'i bstan srung nag po chen po 'di la/

bsnyen pa/ bsgrub pa/ las la sbyar ba la sogs pa chos tshul bsam gyi mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang nas 'dir sgrub pa'am bsnyen pa'i skabs su bab pa yin cing / de yang spyir nag po chen po 'di nyid la gtor ma 'bul ba kho na brtson par byas pa tsam gyi bsnyen bsgrub mi dgos par las rnams 'bad med du sgrub pa rdzogs pa kha cig bzhed la rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa sogs kyi gnyan lo'i dgongs pa gsor bzhag gis bsnyen bsgrub bya tshul gsal po min pa zhig mdzad pa las dus zhag kyang nyer gcig dang sngags kyang 'bum phrag gcig tsam bzlas pas chog par gsungs shing / yang sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi med bdud rtsi 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu las 'bum bzhi tsam bzlas na mchog du legs par gsungs pa dang / ngor chen dpal ldan don 'grub dang sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bzhed pa'ang de dang phyogs mthun par gnang ba las/ 'di ni de dag thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing snyan brgyud zab mo mtha' dag tshad ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin gyis legs par brgyan te/ sdebs sgrigs kyi tshul du go bde bar bkod na/ don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /de las dang po sngon du 'gro ba la mchod gtor dang yo byad bshams pa/ phyi mtshams dang nang mtshams bcad pa'o/ /dang po mchod gtor dang yo byad bshams pa ni/ gnas khang dben zhing yid dang mthun par sra zhing mthas par bla ma gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ de min yang 'dre srin gdug pa can sogs gnas pa'i sa ma yin pa 'dod dgu phun tshogs 'joms pa'i gnas zhig du phyag dar dang byi dor legs par byas la/ sgrub khang gi lho phyogs su sa stegs khru gang gru bzhi dpangs su mtho gang tsam yod pa 'khod snyoms pa'i gzhir khrag dang ro sol sogs kyis byugs pa'i steng du chos 'byung gru gsum rtse mo lhor bstan gyi thig gdab/

de'i steng mañji'i steng du man ngag bzhin btsal ba'i rten rdo gru gsum tshad ldan khrag gi byugs pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir gri khrag gi thig le gru gsum lnga byas/ de rnams kyi steng du khrag gi sbags pa'i 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ steng du dar nag gi gur phub/ de'i mdun du mañji'i steng du lcags snod sogs bug rdol med pa'i snod gang yang rung bar sran ma dang nas nag rjen btags las byas pa'i gtor ma snying bshos gru gsum dbal chen che ba gcig dang de'i phyogs bzhir zur gsum chung ba re re/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du 'dir drag po'i las la shis pa yin pas mtheb kyu drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor/ mtshams bzhir drug cu drug cu rtsigs pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi de dag thams cad smug rtsi'am khrag gi mdog dmar por bsgyur/ rme sha ma yin pa'i sha sna lnga dang / mar tshon gyis mdzes ltar du brgyan/ dar nag la mtshal chen gyis oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar dang mjug du spel tshig la nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi ci bcol ba'i las rnams myur ba nyid du mdzad du gsol/ zhes bris la mda' yi mgul du btags pa 'dzugs shing / steng du dar nag gi gur phub/ gtor ma'i g.yon phyogs su thod pa tshad ldan gyis bkang ba la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang / g.yas phyogs su thod pa'i nang du khrag gtsang ma la bzang drug sogs sman sna dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ 'byor na gri lcags sogs las byas pa'i gri gug rtse gsum/ ral gri/ mdung thung / bum pa/ thod phreng / mi rkang gling bu/ gri snying / 'khor lo la sogs tshul bzhin du bshams/ gtor chen gyi mdun du gta' gtor snod gas chag med par gtor chen dang 'dra bar bshams/༈ 'di'i zur bzhi'i bran leb la smyug ma gtsugs la dar nag 'geb chog par bya/ gzhan yang rang gang byed kyi yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma'ang so so'i phyag len bzhin stegs ji ltar rigs par bshams/

thun mtshams rnams su 'bul rgyu'i thun gtor gru gsum/ dmar po sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar g.yas bskor du gri khrag gtsang ma'i mchod yon/ chu gtsang gi zhabs bsil/ zan la khrag bsres pa'i dbang lnga'i me tog gzugs la bya rkang pa btsugs pa mgon po 'di nyid kyi drag po'i spos sbyor ram ma 'byor na gu gul tshil chen sogs kyi bdug spos/ tshil chen zhu ba'i khu ba cung zad bsres pa'i dar nag gi snang gsal/ khrag dang ga pur bsil sbyar gyi dri mchog sha gang yang rung ba bsres pas zan gyi bshos bu zur gsum lnga la sogs pa/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog bcas bkod pa legs par bshams/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gtor ma rnams kyi rgyab du mgon po 'di'i bris sku bram ze'i gzugs can mchod gtor la zhal phyogs dgram/ sgrub pa po kha lhor phyogs pa'i mdun du rdo dril ḍā ma ru nang mchod 'thor snod la sogs pa phyag len bzhin gsham pa ni dang po bshoms kyi cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i mar ngo'i nyer dgu'am/ nyer gsum la sogs pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi phyi srod la bab pa'i tshe sgrub pa po rang nyid thog mar sgrub khang du cha gsum gtor ma yid ches par btang la/ bgegs bsal/ de nas sgrub grogs gzhan dang bcas sgrub khang gi phyi rol du tho dkar po shin du mngon che ba gcig brtsigs pa'am bris pa'am bcos ma'i kyang rung ste/ de nyid gu gul gyis bdug mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / zlum gtor zhig kyang bshams la/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas tho oṃ ā mṛ tas bsang / swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis shar du yul 'khor srung ljang khu pi waṃ bsgrengs pa/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub du mig mi bzang dmar po mchod rten dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/

byang du rnam thos sras ser po rgyal mtshan dang ne'u li 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can/ rang rang gis g.yog 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ yul 'khor srung 'phags skyes po sna tshogs gzugs/ lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ tsa tur ma ra rā dza sa pā ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las pā d+yaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dren pa'i spyan snga zhal bzhes bzhin/ /bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten skyong / /rdzu 'phrul mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /'jig rten skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tsa tur ma hā rā dza i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gong ltar mchod bstod kyi mjug du/ bstan srung chen po sde bzhi mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phyi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nang du ma btang zhing / nang gi dngos grub phyir ma yal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes pas 'phrin bcol/ de nas ye dhar/ lan gsum/ lag du me tog bzung la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid sems can gyi don rgyun ma chad kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang tho 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas phyi'i bar gcod nang du mi btang zhing / nang gi dngos grub phyir mi yal ba dang / ci bsam chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/

ye dharmā dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha mang du brjod/ me tog gi char dbab/ dril bu'i sgra bya/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i bkra shis dang / /yi dam lha tshogs byin rlabs bkra shis dang / /chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs bkra shis kyis/ /sgrub la bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam la nang du log pa ni phyi mtshams bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa nang mtshams bcad pa ni/ mtshams 'og du sgrub g.yog gcig dang gal te des ma byung na 'di bya snyam pa'i dmigs 'og gcig gnyis zhig sngon ma nas lhus thing par byas la 'jug yid kyis bdag la gnas 'di nyid du yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa'am/ de min yang rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi rtags gang yang rung ba nges par can zhig byung ba la gnam sdib pa'am/ sa g.yos la sogs pa ci byung yang rung gnas 'di nas mi 'da' snyam pa'i dran pa gsal 'debs pa ni nang gi mtshams bcad pa ste/ de rnams ni sngon 'gro rnam gsum gyi rim pa'o/ /dngos gzhi la yang bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa bzlas pa bya zhing mchod bstod 'bul ba mjug bsdu zhing thun mtshams bstan pa dang / sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba bstan pa dang bzhi yod pa las/ deng bdag bskyed pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mchod gtor rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ gu gul gyis bdug yo byad thams cad bdug la/ sgrub pa po rang nyid gtan gyi steng du 'khod/ bla ma la gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor tshul byas la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid drag po las kyi gzhal yas khang thod skam gyi rwa ba gru bzhir brtsegs shing keng rus kyi thog phub pa mi ro rengs pa'i ka gdung lcang lo kha bad/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/

zhing chen gyi bla bre dang rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ bse smug po'i sgo can gyi phyi nang thams cad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zer gyis gtam pa'i mngon spyod rol pa'i pho brang 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs rnams bkug nas bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag gi a/ chu gtsang gi zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ cang te dril bu dung chen gling bu la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu ldan gyi rdzas khyad par can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra a āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar ḍā dril/ dharmā ra ṇi/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas kyai rdor bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i bar/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ gong du bsham pa'i rak+ta/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa rba klong 'khrug cing sbu ba 'khrig pa'i gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥm hā rak+ta rmu dra hūm̐/ rdor thal kha gyen du phye ba'i thod pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa lan gsum gyis byin rlabs/ yang gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥ zhes brjod pas gtor snod thod par gyur par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung por bsam/

lag pa g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub sbyar la gshib srin lag gnyis bsnol/ mdzub mos bzung / mthe'u chung gnyis gshib te/ 'greng ba bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi de dag dpag du med par 'phel zhing 'bar bas bsam/ mtshams la bzhugs pa'i dgongs thun la gtan gtor la dmigs te/ dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la gtor ma 'di rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bcol ba'i las mtha' dag 'bad med du sgrub zin pa'i rjes su 'bul ba lags pas sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa srung ba'i ched du bcol ba'i las 'di myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod la gtor ma dngos su dar nag gi sgrib/ 'di lan gcig po 'di ma gtogs thun byings la mi byed/ de nas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rab du 'jigs pa'i me rlung dmar nag gi yongs su bskor ba'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod chen po brgyad na chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ shing brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub chen brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro sha za srin po ro lang ce spyang khra 'ug keng rus la sogs pa'i yongs su gang ba'i drag po'i dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i dbus su e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dmar zhing dwangs pa rba rlabs chal chil g.yo ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang / phyogs bzhir raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdud thams cad kyi ngo bo mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su dpal rdo rje nag po chen po/

dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog pa'i gzugs can srin po 'phros pa lta bu'i rtsa zhal nag po rngam shing khros pas mi ro rlon pa dmar ser chems chems gsol zhing kha nas khrag 'dzag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po ha ha'i gad rgyang sgrog pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po hūm̐ hūm̐ gi nga ro can/ steng zhal dud kha khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus shing k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi nga ro drag po 'brug sgra 'bum gyi sgra ltar sgrog pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcu kun du dam nyams dgra la bgrad pa/ mche ba rnon po zangs yag du gtsigs shing ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ ma mchu phyir 'chang zhing dbu skra khams pa gyen du zing shing 'bar ba/ phyag bzhis g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug dang g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa khrag dron mos gang ba'i nang nas dam nyams kyi snying dmar 'dar zhing gsol ba/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang / g.yon 'og mas mdung rno ba dan dang bcas pa/ dgra bgegs la 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ rus 'phreng lha ba dmar chil li ba phyag 'gag du bsdus shing / bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung g.yon du thog pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa la rgyus pa'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang tshangs pas skud pas bse ral kha dug sbrul nag pos mchod phyir thog byas pa/ mi rkang gi gling bu dang / gser dngul gyi dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa/ dpa' bo stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ drag la rngam pa'i cha byad zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi steng na 'jigs pa'i bro rdungs shing ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang khu/ mdun du srin mo dmar nag rgyab du siṅga li ser nag bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs can/

phyag g.yas gcod pa'i gri gug dgra la 'phyar zhing / phyag g.yon thod pa khrag bkang gtso bo la stobs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rgyu ma'i ga sha can/ gzhan rgyan spangs shing skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon bskums zhing g.yas brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis srid pa gsum skad cig la nyul ba'i rnam pa can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga'i mtha' bskor du dregs pa pho bdun/ mo bdun/ srog gi sgo bdud nag po/ las kyi shan pa nyer gcig bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag du med pa'i bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gangs ti se/ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod/ siṅgha la/ po tā la/ byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ tsa ri ṭa/ de wi ko tra'i ri sul/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u brag rdzong nag po/ snar thang byang chen spun gsum/ 'or kha/ 'dar stod bla ma'i gdan sa/ dpal ldan sa skya/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bsten sgrub gsol zhing mchod pa'i gnas rnams nas lha mchog ma hā kā la/ lha chen nag po zhal bzhi pa/ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can/ dpa' bo/ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu/ ser nag siṅga li ma/ dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ 'khor gyi lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rlung dmar tshub cing sprin phung thibs pa ltar mdun gyi gnas de nyid du oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di nyid kyi sgrub yig nas gsungs pa'i spos sam tshil chen gu gul sbyar la rdo rje g.yab cing dril bcas dmigs rtse gcig dang ldan pas/ hūm̐ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam sprul las/ /gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms gtum chen mthu stobs can/

/'phrin las drag pos phyogs bcu kun khyab pa'i/ /nag po 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ti si gangs ri po la gnas pa'i tshe/ /myur mgyogs dpa' bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thog /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa 'khor dang bcas/ /dmag dpon chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gru 'dzin lhun po'i ngos la gnas pa'i tshe/ /mi sdug srin po khros 'dra'i zhal bzhi las/ /rnam 'phrul bgrang las 'das pa'i pho nyar 'gyed/ /sprul pa'i mnga' bdag gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /siṅga la yi gling na gnas pa'i tshe/ /mthu ldan nag po 'phrin las thog med sgrub/ /drag po'i gzugs kyi sa gsum 'dar bar byed/ /'phrin las lhun grub gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na gnas pa'i tshe/ /dur khrod bdag mo ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun kyis khyod zhabs 'dud pa'i dpal bo che/ /bram ze'i gzugs can gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ /zhing skyong gdug pa'i 'khor gyis yongs skor nas/ /lha chen thugs kyi pho nya drag shugs can/ /zhing skyong nag po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /me 'bar gnas bzhi'i srung ma mdzad pa'i tshe/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin srung ba'i rnam 'phrul gyi/ /phyogs kun nyul zhing dgra bgegs ma lus 'joms/ /srung ma chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs rgyud sde ma lus dang / /khyad par gsang 'dus mtha' bral stong pa yi/ /chos srung nag po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bar du kha sar pat+s+mi rnal 'byor mas/ /lo chen dar ma grags la mngon sum du/ /khyod nyid g.yog du bka' bsgos rjes 'brang ba'i/ /gnyen mgon nag po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /da lta drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /las kun 'bad med 'grub ces bka' bsgos pas/

/bka' bstod nag po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gtum po'i bka' nyan las sbyor khro mo bzhi/ /zhing skyong lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ṭoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha si/ siṅga li/ de wi sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ mdun du byon par bsam/ gdan 'bul ba ni/ rdor dril bzhag thal mo mdun du bkan la pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas/ pad+ma kā la ya satwaṃ/ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra a nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ dam bzhag ni thal sbyar/ gung mo'i tshigs bar par mdzub mo gnyis bkug srin lag nang du bkug mthi'u chung gnyis gshib ste sbreng / mtheb bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ mgon po'i gnas gsum du btug par bsam la/ oṃ mahā ka la nas/ de wi sa pā ri wā ra'i rjes su sa ma ya smra ra sa ma ya ma tri kra ma/ sa mā ya rak+ṣan+tu/ rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig zab mo la nye bar dgongs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe bsrings/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ 'khor dang bstan pa skyongs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bsod/ gnod par byed pa'i dgra thul/ bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcu kun du rgyas par mdzod cig ces pas dam la bzhag nang mchod dang gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsi/

a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi ma da na kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ mdun gyi nang mchod g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis chos 'byung gru gsum g.yon bskor du 'bri tshul byas pa'i dbus nas blangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i ༈ mtshan smos la/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/༈ gtor dbang skabs kyi bla brgyud/ sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ grub chen dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ dge ba can ma/ dar ma grags/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ grub dbang bkra shis seṅge/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/

mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rab brtan dpal bzang po/ 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba chen po kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ slob dpon kun dga' bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dbang bsdus bkra shis rin chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos kyi rje grub pa'i dbang phyug bzod pa phun tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs gong dang 'dra/ gzhan yang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug lha mchog ma hā kā la/ lha chen nag po zhal bzhi zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu/ ser nag siṅgha li/ dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dregs pa pho bdun/ mo bdun/ srog gi mgo bdun nag po/ las kyi shan pa nyer gcig zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bde chen ye shes yongs su tshim zhing mnyes nas bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med du stsol bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rang gi lce thog du bzhag de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas gong du bshad pa ltar phyag mtshan dngos su bshams na yid kyis sprul te phul ba'i mos par byas nas/ hūm̐/ stobs chen shugs drag gri gug bsnol/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir bzhugs su gsol/

/rgyud rtsub dug gi ngar blud pa'i/ /gri gug mgon po'i phyag na 'bar/ /logs la drag po'i sngags bkod pas/ /mgon po 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'du/ /zhabs ni rdo rje rno ngar ldan/ /gdug rtsub dgra bo'i snying la gzer/ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag du 'bul/ /dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol/ /de bzhin du/ stobs chen shugs drag rtse gsum rno/ gdug pa༞ /rgyud rtsub dug gi༞ /rtse gsum mgon po'i phyag༞ logs la drag po'i༞ /mgon po 'khor bcas༞ /zhabs ni rdo rje'i༞ /gdug can dgra bo'i snying༞ /stobs 'phrog nag po'i༞ /dgra bgegs bsgral phyir༞ /de bzhin du mdung thung ral gri la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de rjes rkang gling byas la/ rkang gling snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs pa'i/ /dam tshig mtshon phyir 'du ba'i brda'/ /stobs 'phrog༞ /dam tshig brten du bzhes su gsol/ /rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis bskang / /dpal ldan mgon po'i phyag du 'bul/ /yid bzhin gter gyi dngos grub bstsol/ /dar nag ba dan g.yab pa'i don/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin 'du/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo dbang du sdud/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i༞ /dung chen phreng mdzes mgul pa'i rgyan/ /bde chen thod khrag bdud rtsis bcud/ /rnal 'byor bskyang phyir phyag na bsnams/ /dam tshig brten du bzhes su gsol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs/ /rtsi bcud sman lnga dri dang ldan/ /khrag zhag chang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /'dod dgu 'byung ba sbu phreng can/ /sman raka rgya mtsho'i mchod pa bzhes/ /gzhan yang gtor ma rak+ta dang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen spos/ /tshil chen mar me la sogs rnams/ /maṇ+ḍal mdun du rten du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol bar mdzod/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus par/ /myur du bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes thugs dam bskang zhing phrin las bcol/ de rnams kyis mdun bskyed grub/

bzlas pa bya zhing mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ 'di nyid kyi spos sam gu gul gyi dud pa sbyar/ mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar sngags thung dang sngags ring gis g.yas bskor du bskor ba gsal btab/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa spros/ de dag gi rtse mo la khrag gi a la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag dang dam rdzas gtor ma gri gug la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan/ bya nag rta nag la sogs pa'i phyi rten/ zhwa nag gos nag la sogs pa'i nang rten/ don snying sha sna lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i gsang ba'i rten rdzas/ gzhan yang stag gzig go khrab gos dar la sogs pa dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sprul te/ mgon po 'khor bcas mnyes zhing / rang gi dam tshig nyes tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag ste 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du 'grub par bsam/ yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po dpag du med par spros mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud dbang med du bskul/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams ni sprul pa'i las mkhan pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog mdung thung ral gri gri gug la sogs pa mtshon cha thogs pa dpag du med par byung ste 'jig rten gyi khams kun khyab ste/ de dag na gnas pa'i bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skad cig nyid la lcags kyus bkug zhag pas bcings mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyi dum bur btub rnam smin gyi phung po'i ro ma rnams kyang ye shes kyi me bsreg dus kyi 'thor rlung gis rjes med du gtor te thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag 'od zer dang sprul pa rnams tshur 'dus/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin brlab nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par tshur 'dus mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar thim/

de las 'od zer dpag du med par byung / bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim pas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi srog gi snying po phul nas ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin 'grub par bsam la/ dmigs pa brten pos thog mar gur mgon gyi yi ge bdun pa nyer gcig de nas oṃ ༈ oṃ gi phyag deb chen mo nas gsal 'dug tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa ye ma hā hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig cho 'phrul shin du che na brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ de nas/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha si/ siṅgha li/ de wi hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso 'khor la 'di kho nar grangs bzung nas thun re la brgya stong khri la sogs pa ci 'grub bzlas pa dang / thun zhabs su sngags ring 'di yang bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ṭa ka ta la/ lam+bhi ta o ṭha/ lam+pa ka be ka lam+ba ka wa lī/ ra bhi ghaṇ+ḍa/ ru tra ma la bi hu re/ tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le sim bi dza li/ ba me kun+dhi dha ri yaṃ/ mā eṃ/ da hi na/ narti ka ro ṭi/ bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ bā me su la pā ṇi/ hā ra dho ra ha ra si la mā la/ pā ta li k+ṣiṃ kā ra ka la ma ha po ṭa la/ ma hā kā la shrī ka bi la/ ki pi la siṃ k+ṣe tra pa la/ hā hā ka re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ka re/ pu bhaṣ+ṣa bhi uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti/ ma hā laṃ pa/ bha ta/ phul+la/ dhu pa/ i ga ha pa liṃ/ dzi gha ha/ da sha dika ut+ta ra wu ri/ ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha si/ sid+ghali/ de wī/ ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ mā ra mā ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ le hi ba liṃ de hi sit+ta/ bi kā la sha truṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ de'i mjug du bha ya na tshar gsum/ thal mo lan bdun brdab la dmigs pa ni lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du 'brub khong gru gsum pa mthing nag gi nang du/ gnod byed lus rid pa skra 'dzings pa mig shi mig du lta ba kha nas khrag skyug pa mgon skyabs dang bral ba zhig bsam/

lag pa g.yas pa gnam lcags las grub pa'i brag ri dug dang mtshon cha dang nad rims kyi me 'od 'phro ba dgra bgegs thams cad phyi mar brlag pa'i mthu ldan du bsam/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa tshogs dpag du med par spros/ gnod byed gang na gnas pa'i sa nas skad cig nyid la bkug cing / lag mthil du bskyed pa'i gzugs brnyan de la sib sib thim pas dgra bgegs dngos su gyur song snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pas ngag du/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas༞ chos༞ dge 'dun༞ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam bral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ las mkhan pu tra nag po/ gnod sbyin baik+tse lcam bral/ srog gcod shan pa brgyad/ rol shan nyi shu rtsa gcig bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bdag gis lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / sngags dang phyag rgya dang rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa 'khrul 'khor dang ting nge 'dzin gyi nus mthu rnams kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra byed pa la sogs bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bsam pa ngan cing sbyor ba rtsub pa'i sgo nas do bsdo ba phod 'dzugs pa sku la bsdo zhing rigs la rnyegs pa byed par sbyor ba rtsub pa/ bsam ngan dug sbyor snga dgra lag la bkal ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/

da dgra sdang zhing gnod pa thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag༞ /yid༞ /mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul༞ stobs༞ des bzlas pa'i sngags kyi 'bras bu ngan pa mtha' dag de nyid kyi thog du smin par gyur cig bdag cag rnams la 'bad cing bskul ba'i lha 'dre mthu bo che thams cad kyang byad ma kho rang gi steng du gshed du phob cig ma hā ka la'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo gsod/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra dpung thul/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su skyol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs zhes brjod la de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ lus bcing bar bgyi'o sogs gsum gyi mthar thal mo brdab pas gong du bshad pa'i sgrub bya de'i lus ngag yid gsum skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas/ ma hā kā la sogs brjod pa'i tshe ro ma rnams phyir dor tshul gyi phyag rgya byas nas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sha rus thams cad khyi ltogs pa la sha byin pa bzhin hab kyi gsol bas thugs rgyud tshim zhing mnyes par bsam mo/ /de nas phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can la byin gyis brlab du gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje nag po chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab du gsol/ phreng ba la phu btab pa spyi bor reg de nas gtor chen dang thun gtor la gong du'ang byin rlabs 'dus pa zhig yod mod/ 'dir slar yang dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa'i phyir/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar pa'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/

de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum mgo thur du bstan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me 'bar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bkol zhing 'od du zhu nas rlangs pa gyen la song bas yig 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ yang yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ yig 'bru gsum yang 'od du zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin brlabs/ sngags thung mjug du/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā gā ta btags pa lan bdun dang / sngags ring lan gsum gyi phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa tur mu kha sa pa ri wa ra a nas shap+ta'i bar/ mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod rdor dril 'dzin pas/ thor thun la bstod pa/ mi rtog dbyings las ma/ snga thun la/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma/ dgong thun la/ ka pā la dang rdo rje gri gug 'dzin/ /kha ga rus 'phreng dgra la 'phyar zhing snun/ /gad rgyang sgrogs pa'i zhal bzhi khro zhing rngam/ /nga yi rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhal bzhi pa/ /stobs 'phrog nag po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /cal col ha ha k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ bzhad sgra can/ /cha lugs 'jigs rung dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /ja ril thod skam dgra mgo'i do shal 'phyang / /nya sha khrag zhag la dga'i gdong bzhi pa/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog /tha mal bram ze mgon po'i tshul bzung nas/ /da lta bstan 'dzin lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /na ga dzu yi cho 'phrul gdong bzhi pa/ /pa ra mi ta'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /pha rol dgra dpung 'joms pa'i nag po che/ /ba spu'i kha nas sprul pa grangs med 'gyed/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gdong bzhi pa/

/tsa ri ti si me 'bar gnas bzhi nas/ /tsha zer lha yi mod la rgyu ba bzhin/ /dzaḥzhes bos tshe thogs med mdun byon pa/ /wa skyes lta bu'i bgegs 'dul gdong bzhi pa/ /zhwa ltar mkhas mang rgya mtshos brten pa'i lha/ /za ltar rno zhing myur bar las kun 'grub/ /'a 'ur bsil bsil dril bu g.yer khas spras/ /ya ma khros pa'i gzugs can gdong bzhi pa/ /ra dung rkang gling la sogs rol mo'i sgra/ /la du la phug la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas/ /sha khrag la sogs dmar chen gtor tshogs kyis/ /sa gsum gang bar mchod do gdong bzhi pa/ /ha ha rgod pa'i zhing skyong gtso 'khor gyi/ /a la sogs mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /ha cang ma rung dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /a tsa ka ltar mgo bo tshal par 'khos/ /hūm̐/ rab 'jigs mun pa'i mdog can zhal bzhi ldan/ /gshin rje khros 'dra'i gzugs thung sgeg pa'i nyams/ /'jigs rung phyag bzhi mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /mi sdug gyed kyi 'phreng 'dzin khyod la 'dud/ /rnam 'phrul du ma'i srid gsum zhing kun nyul/ /nga rgyal shugs kyis dgra bgegs srog rtsa 'byin/ /stobs ldan myur mgyogs sngon gyi dam tshig can/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i shan pa khyod la bstod/ /dam can khyod ni yid la dran tsam dang / /ming nas bos tshe skad cig de nyid la/ /'phrin las thams cad 'bad med 'grub mdzad pa/ /srung ma'i gtso bo gzi ldan dbang phyug bstod/ /khyod kyi g.yas na mi bsrun mun pa'i tshogs/ /shugs can gri gug thod khrag 'chang zhing brdeg /gdug can dgra bgegs myos byed gsod byed ma/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /khyod kyi g.yon na ljang nag khro mo'i gzugs/ /rdug cing phyogs nas zhabs brdebs sa gzhi g.yo/ /gri gug thod 'dzin gar mdzad gad rgyang can/ /dgra bgegs brlag phyir gtum mo khyod la bstod/ /rgyab kyi phyogs nas ser nag rngam zhing grim/ /rdug cing gar bsgyur gri thod 'phyar zhing stobs/

/ngu sgra drag pos rnam pas bla srog 'gug /bstan dgra'i srog len ser ling ma la bstod/ /mdun gyi phyogs nas dmar nag srin mo'i gzugs/ /nu ma rab 'phyang lus ni rak+ta'i byug /gri gug thod 'dzin dgra snying gtso la stobs/ /mgyogs pa'i stobs chen sring mo khyod la bstod/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /mgo brnyan can dang mchu sder can/ /zhag mang po dang mig mang po/ /keng rus gzugs dang gcan gzan tshogs/ /la la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /la la khrag dang nang khrol gyis/ /spar ba bkang nas za zhing rgyug /kha cig sgyu zhag dgra bo bcings/ /la la mi ro mgo nas bza'/ /la la pags pa gson bshus byed/ /kha cig sha gdan dmar po btings/ /la la glo snying dmar po 'dred/ /la la klad khrag drod mo ldeg /kha cig rus pa dub bur bcog /la la dar nag g.yab mo g.yab/ /la la dung chen gling bu 'bud/ /la la rak+ta hub thung byed/ /la la tshil chen dud pa gtong / /la la zhun chen sgron me spor/ /kha cig zhing chen sa la brdeb/ /la la gad mos stong gsum g.yo/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i rlung nag 'tshub/ /chu chen 'khrug cing sa gzhi 'dar/ /thog chen skar mda' 'phen cing bsnun/ /rnam 'phrul mi zad 'khor tshogs la/ /bstod cing bskul lo phrin las mdzod/ /'di tshar chen gyis mdzad/ srod thun la/ hūm̐ gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis/ /lha min bdud kyi dpung tshogs rab bcom nas/ /thub bstan lha dbang grong khyer skyong mdzad pa'i/ /gdong pa bzhi ldan nag po che la bstod/ /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'ang zer/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ /thun gsum brten cing mchod pa'i bsrung ma khyod/ /khams gsum sems can bde la bkod pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' bsgo zhal bzhi pa/ /thugs dam rnam gsum ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ /theg gsum bstan pa'i chom rkun dgra bo 'di/ /bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma'i sku dgra byas/

/rgyud sde gsum gyi srung ma 'di la brnyes/ /dus gsum dregs pas dgra bo 'di sgrol shig /sku gsum brten rnams mnyes shing rnam par bshigs/ /rim gsum chos kyi 'khor lo nyams par byas/ /bslab gsum ldan pa'i dge 'dun bsad bcing byed/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dgra 'di myur du sgrol/ /ces pa 'di bzung pas mdzad/ ces thun bzhir bstod cing bskul lo/ /thun mtshams rnams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni dril bcas/ hūm̐/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi yi tshogs dang bcas/ /las mkhan shu tra nag po 'khor dang bcas/ /gnod sbyin baik+tse lcam bral 'khor dang bcas/ /las kyi shan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /zhing skyong sde brgyad dregs pa 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding ce lcang bya khyi༞ /pho nya la sogs las༞ /'dir gshegs༞ sogs spyi btab dmod bcol cung zad dang bcas sgrub khang de nyid kyi nang du sgom yul dri ma sogs mi phog pa'i sar rdo stegs gtsang ma'i mtshams nam ma grol gyi bar bsags shing 'jog pa'am/ yang dgra phyogs su nyin mo spos dang mtshan mo dpal 'bar btsugs te 'phang ngo / /de rnams ni bzlas pa bya zhing gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa'o/ /spyi don bzhi pa mjug bsdu zhing thun mtshams bstan pa dang / sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba bstan pa ni/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi lhag chad kha bskang / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ khyad par du yang mdun du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa bdag gi sgrub pa dang mngon spyod kyi las rnams mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'di brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs kyi brtan bzhugs/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/

rang nyid kyai rdo rje gsal ba'i mig du gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyi sku skyed sku gsung thugs srung / dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sogs kyis bsngo smon/ mtshungs med bla ma sogs kyi bkra shis kyis mtha' rgyan par bya'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su rang yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ngang nas/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du 'gro chag nyal 'dug sogs spyod lam rnams bzhi de ga'i ngang nas bya/ rab mtshams la bzhugs nas ma thon gyi bar du smra bcad shin du dam pa dang / de min yang thun gyi sgang dang bzlas pa'i skabs ni tshig gi bar ma chod par bya/ dam nyams dang dme po mdza' bo grub mtha' mi gcig pa rnams mi gtong / shin du gtsang zhing gsang bar byed pa gnad kyi che ba yin/ de ltar thun bzhir bcad nas zla gcig gi bar du sgrub pa tshul bzhin du bya/ skabs 'dir rgyal chen gyi tho/ badz+ra muḥgashegs gsol byas la bsdu/ de nas thor thun srod thun gnyis ma chag par byas la mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gyi bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bya/ las kun mthar phyin pa'i rjes su thor thun gyi mjug du sngar gyi gta' gtor de nyid khebs bsangs la nang mchod chu chang gi sbyangs/ thun gtor 'bul ba'i gong du oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ sngags thung lan bdun sngags ring lan gsum gyi phul phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi ci bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med du sgrub pa'i gtang rag du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi byin rlabs te 'bul lo/ /gsol lo mchod do dgyes pa chen pos bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes brjod pas mgon po 'khor bcas rab du dgyes te slar yang rang gis gang bcol ba'i las thams cad sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod na skabs 'dir kyai rdo rje'i nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs pa'i rjes su sman phud nas cung zad phud phor du blugs pa dang bstun/ sman pa'i yul las sogs yang tshogs phud nas gtor chen la cung zad blugs/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru nas phur srung gi gtor sngags kyi bar tshar re dang / khyad par zhal gyi sngags thung gsum dang sngags ring gcig gis bsngos/ de nas sgrub grogs kyi sman phud 'go tshogs sha steng du bzung nas/ 'di rnams chos rnams bzang po ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /de bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /a hoḥsu kha zhes rang gi lag pa g.yas tshogs sha la kha phub du reg g.yon tshogs chang la kha gyen du reg la ngag du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs pa dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /a hoḥsu kha/ zhes brjod cing tshogs la rol/ de rjes gtor chen gta' gtor rnams la spos kyi rengs bu btsugs shing chab kyis bran la/ bskang ba byas tshe rnga brdung dang bcas spyi btab spyi dang khyad par zhal gyi spyi btab la lha mo'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs bcug pa dang gtor ma rnams sgrub khang gi steng du phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs bya/ bskang ba la byas tshe ḍā dril bya'o/ /mjug tshig la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par phyogs bcu na'i mjug du khyad par du yang bla ma yi dam sogs rgyun bzhin gyi rten bzhugs/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes rnams dang tshom bu'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod/ kyis tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba tsam khyad par/

go bgo ba bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams gong bzhin no/ /lhag ma la spos btsugs yig brgya lan gsum a kā ro/ tshar gsum gyi bsngos/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas kha bkru 'debs tshul byas la/ u tsi tra/ sogs rdor glu bkra shis smon lam/ de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar thun bzhi'i tshul gyi zla ba gcig gi bar du sgrub pa tshul bzhin du bgyis na gzhi bsnyen dang sgrub bsnyen gnyis ka'i go chod par snang ste/ de yang gong du bshad pa ltar bla ma so so'i bzhed pa dang / khyad par yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis bzhed pa ltar na mgon po 'di nyid kyi bsnyen tshad kyi grangs 'dzin mi dgos par snang zhing / rgyal dbang mchog gis mdzad pa'i man ngag dogs sel las bla ma 'ga' zhig gis bzhed pas 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzla ba dang dus kyi tshad kyang zhag bdun nas zla ba dgu'i bar la dus bsnyen gyi bsnyen pa tsam gyi tha snyad mdzad par gsungs shing / de la spyir chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad khyad par med par ltar grangs las tshad ma kho na gtso che ba yin la/ 'di ni de dag thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing de rnams kyi dgongs don mtha' dag phyin ci ma log par bkral te bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'gros phyag bzhes kyis legs par brgyan nas dus grangs sogs tshad phab kyi gtan tshigs zhig mkhas blun kun gyi dgongs par bya ba'i phyir brjod na/ de la bdag bskyed pa la rten pa dang mdun bskyed pa la bstan pa'i phyogs gnyis las/ dang po bdag bskyed la rten pa ni mgon po 'di'i chos skor rjes gnang lung man ngag khrid la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa mthar phyin zhing lta ba'i gdengs cung zad yod pa'i gang zag kho na'i blang bya'i yul yin pas 'dir ma brjod la/ mdun bskyed la bstan pa'i phyogs 'di la'ang rab lugs 'di la dgos pas chos skor mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag zhig dgos mod/ de min yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dag las bde kyai gsang gsum la sogs pa bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar smin byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob cing /

de dag gang yang rung ba'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin zhing khyad par mgon po 'di nyid kyi sgrub dus bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang de dag la mkho ba'i rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan rnams kyi lung bcas legs par thob pa'i gang zag zhig ni mi dgos kha med yin la/ thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i rig pa'ang gong du bshad ma thag pa'i sgrub thabs nag 'gros ma 'di nyid thun bzhi'i tshul gyi sgrub tshul yang / thog mar mar ngo gza' tshes bzang 'dzom gyi dgong thun la 'jug par bya ste/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed rgyas pa bzlas pa dang bcas sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ gtor ma spyi bye brag kyai rdor gyi nang mchod ltar byin gyi rlobs/ kyai rdor bde mchog gur mgon rnams la gtor ma phul ba'i rjes su/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa bya ba ni/ rak+ta byin rlabs/ gtor ma byin rlabs/ mdun bskyed sgrub cing spyan drangs pa/ dam bzhag cing bdud rtsi 'bul ba/ phyag mtshan gyi bskang ba rdzogs mtshams bar bya/ de rjes dur bdag nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar so so'i phyag len bzhin/ yi ge brgyad pa de wa pi tsu mgon po lcam dral gyi sngags rnams rgyun gyi bzlas pa bzhin dang / de nas bye brag gi dmigs pa rnams gsal btab te mgon po 'di nyid kyi sngags thung kho na la grangs bzung nas ji ltar rig par bzlas tshar ba'i rjes su sngags ring dang de'i rjes su dur bdag sogs gtor mgron gyi sngags rnams tshang ma bzlas tshar ba'i rjes su bha ya na/ tshar gsum dmod pa thal 'debs/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyi rjes su 'di nyid kyi gtor ma byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sngags thung sngags ring gis phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā la de wi ye tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra a nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ 'dod don dang bla chen 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bshags pa tshar gsum mam gcig la sogs pa gang yang rung ba tshar ba'i rjes su/

bskang ba byas tshe byin rlabs brtsam te rdor glu'i bar dkyus bzhin las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mgon po 'di nyid la bstod pa kā la'i phreng ba la gang thugs ma'i dbyangs bcug pa dang / gtor 'bul gyi tshe mgon chen spyi btab rjes su 'di rang gi spyi btab bcas mdzad rgyu dang / bskang ba mi byed tshe bshags pa'i rjes su mgon po'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung rnams brjod rjes/ bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan srung ma la gong gi bstod pa bsnan pa dang / yang bskang ba dril bsil ma lta bu'i tshe sku dang gsung thugs ma'i mjug du lha mchog ma dang bstod pa gong dang mtshungs/ 'di rang gi spyi btab gtor 'bul sogs 'dra/ de nas srid zhi dpal 'byor ma/ mjug chog rnams dkyus bzhin/ srod thun la gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed lam dus 'bring po'i bzlas pa rdzogs rjes rak+ta'i byin rlabs nas zung 'jug chog gi bar nag 'gros ma 'di bzhin bsnan 'phri med par byed/ thor thun la gnas yo byin brlabs lam dus rgyas pa'am ma lcogs na 'bring po'i bzlas pa rdzogs rjes 'di rang gi tshe sgrub gor bdun ma bsdus tsam zhig byas rjes rak+ta byin rlabs man 'dra/ snga thun srod thun dang mtshungs/ de ltar thun bzhi'i tshul du nyams su blangs nas rtags nges par can rab mgon po nyid kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba/ bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / hor sogs/ mi nag a tsa ra/ bud med/ bla ma dge bshes/ dar 'phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa/ gtor ma me 'bar ba/ mi rkang gling bu 'bud pa sogs byung ba dang / dngos su sgrub khang tshig pa dang sa g.yo ba/ gzi che ba/ sgrub rdzas rnams las sgra 'byin pa/ rang nyid kyang shes pa dwangs shing sgrub pa la spro ba/ lus kyi spu ldang ba la sogs pa dang / 'jigs snang dang grib gnon lta bu'i thibs thibs byung ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams lan gcig min pa yang skyar nas byung na mgon po 'di nyid bsgrub pa'i rtags su gsung la/

yang de min rmi ltas su mtshon cha rtsa zlum pa/ bya nag khyi nag sogs mdog ngan pa dang / a tsa ra/ hor sog po khros pa dang / bud med rgyan cha med pa'i ngu ba la sogs byung na mgon po 'di nyid kyi khu ldog gi rnam pa cung zad yin pas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing chos skyong nyid la gtor tshogs sngar bas kyang che zhing bzang bar bshams te bskang bshags la brtson par gal che/ de ltar zla ba gcig gi bar du bzlas brjod la brtson par byas pa'i sgo nas sngags thung la 'bum khrag bzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas na gong ma rnams kyi yig cha so so'i dgongs pa dang yang mi 'gal zhing sgrub pa po rnams kyang nyams su len bde zhig byung bar kho bo sems pas skal bzang spyod ldan dag gi dgongs par mdzod/ de rnams kyi mjug bsdu zhing thun mtshams bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba bshad pa zhal byung rtags dang bsnyen pa'i tshad bshad pa dang bcas pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ /'phags bod mkhas grub zhal skyugs mtsho chen las/ /bsnyen brgyud bsam 'phel dbang rgyal legs blangs te/ /ngo mtshar dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /gdul bya'i re ba skong phyir e ma mtshar/ /bdag gi lung dus bstan pa'i mjug skyes kyang / /tshe sngon las dkar bsags pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes su bzung / /zab chos mtha' dag thob 'di skal ba bzang / /khyad par nag po chen po che chung gi /man ngag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi lung / /snying nang khrag thig zab dgu'i nor mdzod kyi/ /rin chen gser gyi lde mig bdag gi brnyed/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gis ma zin zhing / /don med don log bsgrigs pa'i bstan bcos dang / /'di nyid mi mtshungs mkhas pa'i spyod yul du/

/'gyur ba kho na yin no bskal bzang rnams/ /de lta bas na chos skyong 'di nyid kyi/ /bsnyen bsgrub las gsum byed pa'i gang zag gis/ /thog mar 'di yi man ngag zhib par nos/ /de rjes sgrub thabs 'di la 'bad par gces/ /dkon mchog bstan la gnod byed dgra byung tshe/ /drag po mtshon cha 'bar ba 'di phyung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog chod rnam par shes/ /mi bskyod dag pa'i zhing du 'dren par mdzod/ /bstan srung gtso bo zhing skyong dbang po 'di/ /bsrung ma gzhan las mthu rtsal che gyur bas/ /bsnyen bsgrub gtor ma 'bul la brtson tsam gyis/ /'dod yon sgrub pa 'di yi nges tshig yin/ /grub mtha' mi mthun dam med log blta can/ /las 'bras khyad sod slob ma bslu rnams kyis/ /rna ba'i bu gar tshig tsam mi smra bar/ /shin du gsang zhing sba ba'i gnas su mdzod/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal stobs 'phrog nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i shin du zab pa'i man ngag bsnyen sgrub gsal byed drag po mtshon cha'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid na mgon po 'di'i las tshogs gtor chen 'phangs pa'i rgyun zhig gong ma dag gis phyag bzhes 'dug na'ang de dag gi zor 'dzin pa dag gi gzhi bsnyen sgrub bsnyen pa la ngos 'dzin dka' ba bcas gnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug gi lo'i zor 'dzin las thog ban tshang pa dpal 'byor yar 'phel nas bsnyen sgrub bya tshul go bde bklag chog zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ dang por 'chi med 'od gsal rigs thig bar du srin mo dang 'khon pas na 'khon gdung / tha mar sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i grags dkar srid pa gsum na bsgrog pa'i rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud du skyes pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes dam pa'i rigs su skyes kyang yon tan gyi dri mas dben pa bdag gi rdo rje 'chang dngos tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa sgrub thabs 'phrin las myur mgyogs ma gzhi byas/
